verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a SaaS spend platform like Brex, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a way to choose where customer data is stored. Mentions of operating in '120+ countries' and of the Team API managing 'locations' describe service availability and company office locations, not data storage region, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
